newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malpac seeks okay to buy finance firm.
newsitem.headline: Malpac seeks okay to buy finance firm.

text.p: Malaysian stockbroking and property firm, Malpac Holdings Bhd said on Monday it was seeking the approval from the central bank to start negotiations to acquire a stake in a financial firm.

"...Malpac is pleased to announce an interim announcement that the company is seeking approval from Bank Negara Malaysia to commence negotiation to acquire an equity interest in a company involved in financial services", the company said in a statement.
Pending approval from the central bank, Malpac requested the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange to continue suspending its stock from trading.
The stock was suspended from April 21, being last traded at 7.50 ringgit.
